'''Ion miners''' operated out of [[Exis Station/Legends|Exis Station]] during the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. As the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Teedio]] grew ever more unstable, ion miners and [[solar-flare skimmer]]s engaged in a booming industry, taking risks to exploit the energy resource.<ref name="Firestorm">{{JournalCite|15|Firestorm (short story)}}</ref>
